titles.display: Five Days of Milan

raw.description: 1848 conflict during the First Italian War of Independence
raw.extract: The Five Days of Milan was an insurrection and a major event in the Revolutionary Year of 1848 that started the First Italian War of Independence. On 18 March, a rebellion arose in the city of Milan which in five days of street fighting drove Marshal Radetzky and his Austrian soldiers from the city.
